units.summary: Adds a new compaction hint setter that appends the 'from-selected-series' hint idempotently and keeps hints sorted. Mirrors SetStaleSeries and is persisted in block meta.

units.summary: Write now propagates the selected-series hint from the base meta to the new block, like stale-series and OOO hints.

units.summary: Blocks with the selected-series hint are now excluded from the in-order max time computation, like stale and OOO blocks. This affects the watermark used for in-order/OOO decisions.

units.reason: Alters the in-order watermark used in head/OOO logic.
focus: Selected-series blocks excluded does not cause head min-valid-time regressions
